headline: Bahraini broadcaster stripped of UK licence over Houthi leader speech praising October 7 attacks
label: NEWS
caption:
A Bahraini broadcaster has lost its official UK licence after airing a speech by a Houthi leader that praised the October 7 attacks, according to The National.

Regulators took action against the network following the broadcast, which featured the Houthi leader commending the ass@ult on Israel.

The decision highlights growing scrutiny over foreign media broadcasts and the enforcement of local broadcasting standards in Britain.
